 TV Shows Published November 10, 2026 ‘VisionQuest’ Cast and Showrunner Assemble for the Series Finale 
 Paul Bettany, James Spader, and Emily Hampshire joined showrunner Terry Matalas to celebrate the final episode of ‘VisionQuest’ at a special screening event. 
 BY William Shammah >PROGRAM: VISIONQUEST [FINAL SEQUENCE LOADING…]  
 Marvel Television’s  VisionQuest   set Vision on a journey of self-discovery, one that forced him to face his father-figure, Ultron , and reunite with his son, Tommy Shepherd , on the search for his own humanity. Now, the synthetic android’s quest comes to an end, with the series finale streaming November 10 at 6pm PT, only on Disney+.
 Showrunner  Terry Matalas was joined by  Paul Bettany (Vision),  James Spader (Ultron), and  Emily Hampshire (E.D.I.T.H.) at the  VisionQuest finale event in New York City, where they played the final episode for fans and spoke about their experience bringing the series to life.
 Paul Bettany’s Vision acts as the show's multi-generational anchor, putting the beloved Avenger in the shoes of both father and son. “When Terry and I were first talking about the show, we really wanted it to be about fathers and sons,” revealed the  VisionQuest actor and executive producer. “And I was like, that's genius because now we can do intergenerational damage with robots and lasers.”
 Matalas gave fans a little foreword before screening the series’ final episode, which concludes the visionary trilogy that started with WandaVision. “It’s a bit nerve-wracking because there are a couple of really big swings in this,” the showrunner shared with the crowd. “You know, all good endings touch upon the beginning.”
 After the final episode of  VisionQuest fades to black, fans can join Paul Bettany, James Spader, Ruaridh Mollica, and showrunner Terry Matalas as they sit down with Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez for the  VisionQuest Official Podcast . Together, they’ll dive into Easter eggs sprinkled throughout the show and share behind-the-scenes stories from their time on set. Watch on Disney+, Marvel's YouTube, or listen wherever you get your podcasts, on November 10 at 6pm PT.
 Stream the series finale for Marvel Television’s VisionQuest tonight at 6pm PT, only on Disney+.
